title: Custom hook not applied in `_bridge()` and `_quote()`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The `_bridge()` and `_quote()` in the `MultiChainHyperlaneTellerWithMultiAssetSupport` contract fail to apply a custom post-dispatch hook set via the `setHook()`.
